captured_by: tools/java-harness (DumpHome), Sweet Home 3D 7.5 io code on JDK 17

dream_house.origin: User-provided example: a real home exported from Sweet Home 3D (2019, version 6000; inch units). 152 furniture, 79 walls, 15 rooms, 6 levels, 10 dimension lines.

artifacts.home.dump.json: Recursive field dump of the Home object graph (parity oracle). $class/$ref markers; UUID-shaped ids normalized to <prefix>-<ordinal>; content entries referenced by zip entry name.
artifacts.Home.xml: Canonical XML entry, extracted verbatim from the zip.
artifacts.content/: All non-home zip entries (models, textures) extracted verbatim.
artifacts.references/dream_house.svg: Plan SVG export from the Java app (FreeHEP PlanComponent$SVGSupport).
artifacts.references/dream_house.csv: Furniture list CSV export from the Java app.

generated.origin: Programmatically-built feature-covering homes: walls (straight/arc/connected/tapered/baseboards), rooms (rect/concave/textured), furniture (catalog pieces rotated/mirrored + door/window + light + shelf + group), levels (3), dimensions-labels (dimension lines/labels/polylines with caps/dashes/arrows), cameras (observer/top/stored/path), environment (sky/ground/drawing-mode/compass), big (1000 furniture), serialized-only (legacy serialized Home entry, no Home.xml), damaged (missing content entry -> repaired=true).

artifacts.dumps/<name>/home.dump.json: Field dumps captured by DumpHome for each generated fixture.
